name: Unreal MCP (Unreal Engine)
summary: Epic's experimental Unreal Engine 5.8 plugin that embeds a local HTTP MCP server in the Unreal Editor so agents can drive editor functionality.
description: Plugin identifier `ModelContextProtocol`; tools come from the AllToolsets/Toolset Registry plugins (actors, lighting, materials, Slate inspection, automation tests and more). Binds to `http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp` by default; HTTP and SSE only (no stdio/WebSocket); loopback-only with no authentication layer. Also available in UEFN (beta).

agent_access.notes: Built into Unreal Editor; binds locally to http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp (port and path configurable).
